title: feat(cli): os init scaffolds a starter app and list view, so a new project opens in the Console with its own object
body:
Fixes #32212

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os init` 默认的 `app` 模板现在多写一个入门应用 `src/apps/main.app.ts`（导航里只有一项，打开模板自带的对象）和该对象的列表视图 `src/views/NAMESPACE_item.view.ts`；`plugin` 模板只多写列表视图，不带应用；`empty` 模板不变。
- 为什么改：以前 `os init` 出来的项目启动后，对象能通过 REST/MCP 访问，但没有任何应用列出它，新用户按启动横幅打开 Console 只看到平台自带的应用，看不到自己的项目。这与 #32209 对 `npm create objectstack` 的修复是同一个问题的另一个脚手架。
- 风险与回滚：只影响新生成的项目，已有项目不受影响。一个可见后果：`app` 类型的包最多只能有一个应用（ADR-0019 D3），所以新项目里再跑 `os g app` 会被拒绝，作者应往入门应用里加导航项（与 #32209 的 blank 模板相同）；目录里已有 `src/apps/index.ts` 或 `src/views/index.ts` 时保留原文件、只追加一行导出，不覆盖。回滚即还原 `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`（`wiredBarrelExporting` 与 `writeTemplateSrcFiles` 里新增的追加分支，最有风险的一段）；`packages/cli/test/generate-scaffold-wiring.test.ts` 第 5 节（新的行为钉子）；`packages/cli/test/init-template-comments-self-contained.test.ts`（`../` 规则改为按深度判断）。
- 两分钟验证：在任意空目录运行 `objectstack init demo --no-install && cd demo && objectstack validate`，预期输出 `UI: 1 Apps  1 Views` 且校验通过、无警告。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`os init` scaffolds its objects and, until now, no app, so a project booted with its object served over REST and MCP and nothing of its own in the Console, which lists an object only where an app's navigation names it.

- **`app` template** (the default): writes `src/apps/main.app.ts`, an app named `NAMESPACE_main_app` labelled with the project's title, whose one navigation entry opens the starter object, and `src/views/NAMESPACE_item.view.ts`, that object's list view (a grid of every field it declares, sorted by its title field). Each is exported from its directory's `index.ts`, which the config already wires. The files are what `os g app main --object NAMESPACE_item` and `os g view NAMESPACE_item` write, and the barrels are the empty barrel plus the line those generators append: the apps barrel is byte-identical to the one `create-objectstack`'s blank starter ships since #32209.
- **`plugin` template**: writes the list view and **no app**. Judgment, with the reason: a view travels with its object, so a host that names the object in its own navigation opens this list; navigation is the host's to compose, and an app shipped in a metadata package would land in the app switcher of every stack that loads it. The template also has no `dev` or `start` script, so there is no Console of its own for an app to fill.
- **`empty` template**: unchanged. It declares no object, so there is nothing for an app entry or a view to name (`os g app` itself refuses without an object).
- **The route the card asked to be named**: the object is referenced through an import of its module (`ITEM.name`), never as a typed-out name, as #32209 does with `Note.name`. Renaming the object in its own file moves the app entry and the view with it. The other route, teaching `create-objectstack`'s rename to move `objectName`/`object` literals, lives outside this card's surface and is not needed for `os init`, which renders the names per project.
- **One consequence, stated rather than hidden**: a package whose manifest type is `app` holds at most one app (ADR-0019 D3, enforced by `defineStack`). With the starter app in place, `os g app NAME --object OBJECT` in a fresh `os init` project is refused (exit 1, "must define at most one app … Fold them into one app with multiple tabs", and the command takes its write back out). Before this change the first `os g app` succeeded. The starter app's own comment therefore tells the author to add a navigation entry to it (a `group` entry nests them) rather than a second app, and the nightly reach e2e now pins that refusal before it removes the starter app and runs every generator as before. This is the same shape #32209 shipped for the blank starter.
- **Scaffolding into a non-empty directory** (`os init` with no name): an existing `src/apps/index.ts` or `src/views/index.ts` is kept, and the template's export line is appended once if the file lacks it, the way `os generate` appends to a barrel it finds. Empty barrels keep the existing rule (never written over an existing file).

The producer is `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`, as the card named. `generate.ts` and `packages/create-objectstack/**` are untouched.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/test/generate-scaffold-wiring.test.ts`, new top-level describe `[#32212] a scaffolded project lists its objects in an app, each with a list view`: scaffolds each template through the real emitter and loads its config the way `os validate` does; asserts every object has exactly one list view binding it with the object's own fields as columns, the `app` template's app navigates to every scaffolded object, the `plugin` template ships no app, `empty` ships nothing, and renaming the object's `name:` in its own file moves the app entry and the view with it (with no `'NAMESPACE_item'` literal in any app or view file).
- Same file: the empty-barrel probes moved from the views barrel (now non-empty) to the flows barrel; a new case pins the append-once behaviour on an existing views barrel, including a file with no trailing newline and a second run that writes nothing.
- `packages/cli/test/create-objectstack-wiring-parity.test.ts`: the compared `os init` barrel is the rendered barrel minus the generator export lines, i.e. the empty barrel. One export-line pattern serves both this and the #32209 assertions.
- `packages/cli/test/init-template-comments-self-contained.test.ts`: the `../` entry now judges depth, as its own comment prescribed for this exact condition and as `create-objectstack`'s copy does since #32209. `../objects/NAMESPACE_item.object` from `src/apps/` stays inside the project; a climb above the project root still reddens.
- `packages/cli/test/generate-scaffolds-reach-stack.e2e.test.ts` (nightly): first `os g app` beside the starter app must be refused by the one-app rule with nothing written; then the starter app is removed (file and barrel line) and every generator runs as before. `os validate` counts 1 App and 2 Views (the starter's list view plus the generated one).
- `packages/cli/test/starter-field-consumers.e2e.test.ts` needs no change: since #32209 its control unwires any view a starter ships, which now includes this one.

## Acceptance notes

- `os validate` on a `-t plugin` scaffold prints the advisory "No apps or plugins defined — this stack may not do much". It printed the same before this change (the plugin template never had an app), and it follows from the plugin judgment above; noted, not changed.
- The starter list view's label is `All NAMESPACE_TITLE Items` and the app entry's `NAMESPACE_TITLE Items`, where `os g view` would print the object's singular label (`All My App Item`): the object declares no plural label, so the scaffold spells the plural itself.
- Found beside this card, reported to the seat for filing (not fixed here, outside the surface): the blank starter's `src/apps/main.app.ts` comment, its README and `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx` tell the author to "generate an app of its own" with `objectstack generate app NAME --object OBJECT`; in that project the command is refused by the same one-app rule (measured on a copy of the template at this head: exit 1, "An 'app' package must define at most one app, but found 2").
- The docs page `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` describes `-t plugin` as writing "`objectstack.config.ts` … plus `src/objects/*.object.ts`"; it does not list views. Still true as far as it goes; not edited here (outside this card's surface).

## Verification

All readings below are on this branch at `fe206cab5` unless a line names another head (each named head differs from `fe206cab5` only by the starter app's comment text and the changeset).

<details><summary>Targeted tests at fe206cab5: 13 files, 264 tests, green</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` over the 12 unit-tier files that pin `os init` (init, init-scaffold-authoring-rules, init-template-comments-self-contained, init-scaffold-file-name-registry-parity, create-objectstack-wiring-parity, generate-scaffold-wiring, scaffold-emission-typechecks, scaffold-test-script-passes, scaffold-object-declaration-shape, scaffold-manifest-schema, starter-field-consumers, init-manifest-id): `Test Files 12 passed (12)`, `Tests 256 passed (256)`.
- `--project integration test/generate-stack-reach.test.ts test/scaffold-test-script-passes.test.ts`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
- Nightly, `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly … test/generate-scaffolds-reach-stack.e2e.test.ts`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 14 passed (14)`, including the new one-app refusal case.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suite and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`) at `fe206cab5`: exit 0, "test layer compiles … 3 file(s) / 28 error(s) / 6 pinned signature(s) held".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` at `7122465ff`: `Test Files 2 failed | 410 passed (412)`, `Tests 5857 passed | 29 skipped`. The two files (`published-subpath-console.pin`, `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`) refused before running because `packages/cli` itself was not built ("packages/cli is not built … Run: pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build"); after that build both ran: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 29 passed (29)`. The `integration` layer is declared to CI apart from the files named above.
- Nightly `starter-field-consumers.e2e` and `init-created-files-summary.e2e` at `7122465ff`: both passed (2 of the 3 files in that run; the third, the reach e2e, was then adapted to the one-app rule and is green above).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, not kept)</summary>

With the app entry's `objectName: ITEM.name` replaced by a typed-out `'NAMESPACE_item'` (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `d3dd3002` to `23d6bffd`), `generate-scaffold-wiring.test.ts` went red on exactly one test: "`app`: renaming the object in its own file moves the app entry and the view with it" (`Tests 1 failed | 46 passed`). Restored: `git hash-object` equals the HEAD blob `d3dd3002`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Boot: a real os init project in the Console's API</summary>

`os init demo --no-install` then `os validate`: "Validation passed", `UI: 1 Apps  1 Views`, no warnings; `os lint`: "All checks passed". `os compile` then `os serve --dev` on a random port, signed in as the dev admin:

- `GET /api/v1/meta/app` answered 200 with `demo_main_app` (navigation: `demo_item`) beside `setup` and `account`.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/view` answered 200 with `demo_item.default`, `object: demo_item`, label "All Demo Items", columns name/description/status, `_diagnostics.valid: true`.
- `GET /api/v1/data/demo_item` answered 200, `total: 0`.

The server was stopped by its recorded pid and the port was free afterwards. `os init pkg -t plugin`: `os validate` passed with `UI: 1 Views`.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (derived at `a5af54126`, same 68 families re-derived at the final diff): 63 exit 0; 5 NOT MEASURED, each exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET because they read the build of packages outside the CLI's closure (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:type-check-debt`); CI runs them. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 5 NOT-MEASURED". Re-run at `fe206cab5` after the last changeset edit: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:scaffold-emission-policy`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, all exit 0. `eslint --no-inline-config` over the changed source and test files: exit 0, no findings.

</details>
